## Southland Announces First Quarter 2026 Results


Southland Holdings, Inc. (NYSE American: SLND and SLND WS) (“Southland”), a leading provider of specialized infrastructure construction services, today announced financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Revenue of $172.4 million for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, compared to $239.5 million for the quarter ended March 31, 2025.
